# Release Astronomical 0.2.47
Astronomical 0.2.47 ships the work merged into `main` after the v0.2.46 stable tag, plus new coding-agent start material and website refinements.
## What is new
- **Better long-term expert retention on paged MoE models.** The adaptive memory guard now excludes one-time streamed expert-page payloads from the learned prefill-activation budget. Previously, experts streamed from storage, promoted, and evicted inside a single forward were counted toward the residual-growth evidence, which inflated the learned activation reserve and shrank the long-term expert-retention budget. The residual now reflects true activation cost, keeping the expert budget steadier across long and repeated prompts. - **Finer performance attribution.** New admission-reserve source counters report exactly where the transient reserve is resolved — exact context, phase-scaled estimate, or global maximum. - **Menu app stability.** Removes an orphaned settings scene that could open a blank window on launch, and hardens thin-talk failure handling. - **Coding-agent start.** Publishes Observatory connection material and website getting-started samples, plus a Pi recipe that works out of the box. - **Website.** Readable font sizes, current Stable version shown on the homepage, and report-page sizing fixes.
## Compatibility
- No configuration schema change; existing config, model discovery, and library catalog carry forward unchanged. - Prompt-cache, expert state, and user state are preserved. - The single-model-resident architecture is unchanged.
## Distribution
- Distribution is a single notarized and stapled macOS DMG, plus a signed Sparkle update feed. - Verify the released DMG SHA-256 against the published manifest, and confirm the appcast enclosure Ed25519 signature validates against the embedded public key.
